name: claude-session help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:claude-session (Claude agent picker).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Choose Claude's agent…
entries.text: Opens the agent picker: pick which crew agent every new Claude session works as.

entries.title: Claude sessions
entries.text: Settings for Claude sessions: the agent every session works as, and whether you are asked each time a session starts.

entries.title: Agent row
entries.text: Tap an agent's row to see every stat: jobs done, success and failures, average cost and time, recent runs, write-ups, raises and persona.

entries.title: Persona
entries.text: How a Claude session talks while it works as this agent. Every session assigned to the agent follows it.

entries.title: Voice
entries.text: Voice notes for this agent (tone, accent, pace). Voice Amber uses them when it works as the agent.

entries.title: Save persona
entries.text: Saves this agent's persona and voice notes. Sessions pick them up the next time they ask who they are.

entries.title: Card
entries.text: Opens this agent's employee card in the Breakroom.

entries.title: History
entries.text: Shows this agent's past runs and status history.

entries.title: Session browser
entries.text: Opens this agent's sessions in the Session browser.

entries.title: Terminal
entries.text: Opens a Terminal tab for this agent's current run.

entries.title: Group chat
entries.text: Opens the crew's group chat.

entries.title: Find an agent
entries.text: Filters the list by name, role or current job.

entries.title: Pick
entries.text: Picks this agent. From a session's pop-up it answers that session; otherwise it becomes Claude's default agent.

entries.title: Claude agent
entries.text: The agent every new Claude session works as until you pick another, and the one kept when you don't answer.

entries.title: Ask me every session
entries.text: On: each new voice, chat or Claude Code session pops the agent picker here and sends an approval to your phone. Off: sessions just use the Claude agent.

entries.title: Ask for headless too
entries.text: Off: headless builds keep the agent their brief names, with no prompt. On: they ask like any other session.

entries.title: Choose Claude's agent…
entries.text: Opens the agent picker.

entries.title: Assign to Claude
entries.text: Makes this agent the one every new Claude session works as.

entries.title: Claude's agent
entries.text: This agent is already Claude's agent.

entries.title: Transcript
entries.text: Opens the Audio Output Recorder on this session’s recordings, with what was said in each part.
